proposed_fixes.title: Keep Color Picker magnifier inside the target display
plan: Define whether magnifier containment uses full display bounds or work area and retain physical-pixel coordinates.
Clamp the desired rectangle before the existing target-display placement helper; handle displays smaller than the desired window without negative clamp bounds.
Preserve captured center/selected pixel and verify capture padding separately instead of changing the shared helper for all callers.
verification: All four edges/corners at100%,150%,200% scaling, including negative monitor coordinates and mixed-DPI transitions.
Window bounds remain inside the chosen target bounds and the selected color/sample is unchanged.
Repeat zoom-in/out and reopen sessions; check taskbar overlap contract and small-display behavior.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The final zoom rectangle is centered on the cursor without a display-bound clamp, so edge/corner positions place part of the window off-screen.

confidence.rationale: The unbounded current rectangle and non-clamping callee are direct evidence; interactive sample anchoring and DPI regressions remain unexecuted.

evidence: Original report supplies an edge/scroll reproduction and screenshot; maintainer independently confirmed clipped content.
The discussion distinguishes off-screen magnifier placement from black capture padding and confirms persistence after a later needinfo request.
Current ZoomWindowHelper.ShowZoomedImage computes left/top as cursor minus half the physical window size and passes that rectangle to FlyoutWindowHelper.MoveAndResizeOnDisplay.
The shared helper performs target-display DPI teleport and uses the final rectangle unchanged; it does not clamp its edges. No interactive mixed-DPI run was performed.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce current edge/corner placement, then design a monitor-bound clamp that preserves the selected pixel and existing DPI transition behavior.
judgment.rationale: A cursor at a display edge yields an off-display rectangle by inspection, and the final helper does not repair it. Placement and capture padding are distinct: moving the window alone must not silently change the sampled pixel or claim to fix pixels outside the source display.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current placement/callee flow supports a bounded fix direction; cursor/sample anchoring and mixed-DPI behavior still require UI verification.

steps: Start Color Picker at each display edge and corner, then scroll to zoom.
Record magnifier bounds, selected pixel/color and whether content or only capture padding is off-screen.
Repeat after crossing to a differently scaled monitor and after closing/reopening zoom.
prerequisites: Interactive desktop with known monitor bounds/scaling.
Prefer a second monitor with a different scale and negative desktop coordinates.
reproduce.expected: The magnifier remains visible within the selected display bounds while the sampled pixel and zoom behavior remain correct.
